description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in precision for different configurations of tokens and bit precision in a KV cache compression system. The x-axis represents different layers of the system, specifically Layer 13-20 and Layer 21-28. The y-axis measures the relative change in precision, ranging from -15% to 5%. The plot includes four lines representing different configurations: LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit (red line with square markers), RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit (blue line with circle markers), RULER4k of 4×tokens, 4-bit (yellow line with diamond markers), and Baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit (gray dashed line with no markers). The red line shows a significant drop in precision at Layer 13-20, followed by a recovery and a peak at Layer 21-28. The blue line shows a similar trend but with less pronounced changes. The yellow line remains relatively stable throughout, while the gray dashed line shows a slight increase in precision across the layers.
